summary: Falcon's Beyond Global, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) announcing that its 11% Series B Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock began trading on the Nasdaq Global Market under symbol FBYDP on May 21, 2026. No merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. The filing is a routine listing announcement with no special-situation elements. The company issued a press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1, but disclosed no deal terms, premiums, or advisor involvement. This event does not constitute a change of control, restructuring, or capital return. There is no risk-arb angle or unusual corporate action; it is simply a preferred stock listing.
